key_findings: **Sqwt::FrameworkElement IDENTIFIED as primary intermediate UI layer** (FUN_0092F640, 1373 bytes). Calls Sqwt::UIElement::ctor as base; writes Sqwt::FrameworkElement::vftable at THREE offsets (+0x00 primary, +0xB4 secondary overrides UIElement, +0x194 tertiary replaces Sqwt::Markup::IAddChild). Has 20 callers = 20 FrameworkElement-derived class ctors. Sqwt-side UI chain: Sqwt::FrameworkElement <- Sqwt::UIElement <- Sqwt::InputElement <- ....

**Sqwt::UIElement::dtor IDENTIFIED** (FUN_0093AC10, 201 bytes). Restores UIElement::vftable at both +0x00 and +0xB4 (standard MSVC dtor-vftable-reset pattern). Confirms the 2 writers of UIElement::vftable_SECONDARY are ctor + dtor only - derived classes do NOT write UIElement's secondary, they write their own.

**The +0xB4 mechanism in client-architecture 'The Sqwt event-source registry is per-channel' is the literal MSVC multiple-inheritance SECONDARY VTABLE**, not a pointer-to-interface-object field. The vtable IS the data at +0xB4 of the object (laid out by the compiler). The `event_source->vtable[+0xB4]->slot[+0x28]` should be read as `secondary_vtable_at_(this+0xB4)->slot[+0x28]`. Dynamic dispatch at +0xB4 works correctly because each class along the inheritance chain provides its own secondary vtable at that offset.

**Sqwt::FrameworkElement has 3 vftables** (a triple-vtable multi-inheritance layout): PRIMARY 0x0106AB80 at +0x00; SECONDARY 0x0106AB94 at +0xB4; TERTIARY 0x0106ACBC at +0x194 = decimal 404. The tertiary slot corresponds to Sqwt::Markup::IAddChild interface (RTTI Base_Class_Descriptor for IAddChild has offset 404). FrameworkElement-derived classes that participate in XAML-style markup add-child parsing use the IAddChild interface via this tertiary vtable.

**Sqwt::UIElement RTTI Class Hierarchy Descriptor reveals 8 base classes** (numBaseClasses=8 in 0x01141914..0x01141944), 2 of which are at offset 180 (=0xB4) = secondary vtable segment. The first base-class-descriptor at offset 0 has its OWN nested Class Hierarchy Descriptor with 5 more bases - indicating the UIElement primary base has its own deep inheritance subtree.

**Sqwt::Markup::IAddChild::vftable identified** (0x0106AB24). XAML-style 'parent that can have children added' interface. Allows XAML parsing infrastructure to call AddChild() / AddText() on parents during tree construction.

**Sqwt::FrameworkElement::LogicalChildrenList** embedded at FrameworkElement+0x258 (param_1[0x96]). Self-referential pointer at +0x254 (param_1[0x95] = param_1+0x96). Represents the framework's LOGICAL children (vs visual children) for XAML content trees.

**20 FrameworkElement-derived classes confirmed** via call-sites of FUN_0092F640 (Sqwt::FrameworkElement::ctor). Sites: FUN_00679ED0, FUN_0097B920, FUN_0091BC90, FUN_00995B70, FUN_009BA170, FUN_0099C460, FUN_009C9C60, FUN_009B5A30, FUN_0069D140, FUN_0097BB70, FUN_00990560, FUN_009C96B0, FUN_0099D650, FUN_0090EA40, FUN_0090F010, FUN_009A5B70, FUN_009CA9A0, FUN_009C9B30, FUN_0096A230, FUN_00938C80. Each is the ctor of a distinct FrameworkElement-derived class (likely Sqwt::Window, ListBox, Button, ScrollBar, ComboBox, Panel, etc. and Application-namespace specializations).
